Supreme Court to hear plea on airfare fluctuation guidelines

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear a plea on July 13 seeking guidelines to regulate unpredictable fluctuations in airfares. The petition also calls for the establishment of an independent regulator to ensure transparency and protect passengers in the civil aviation sector. The plea was filed by a social activist.
